# decisions

<!-- Generated by `pixi run kb-index` from the concepts' frontmatter; do not edit. -->

## Design Decision

* [Sprint H: near-degenerate flavour groups merge at rounding, split when physical; decay-chain duplicates decided after MadGraph is measured](D1-near-degenerate-merge-rounding.md) - D1: GROUP_REL_TOL rises to about 1e-9 so rounding-level pairs merge, and pairs above it (the CP-odd 8e-7 γ+jets split) are separate groups instead of refused. D2: item 5's behaviour is chosen after MadGraph's own is measured.
* [Sprint H: decay-chain duplicate subprocesses match MadGraph; per-group cut indicators come into scope](D3-decay-duplicates-match-madgraph.md) - D3: a subprocess reached by two decay assignments is kept as two subprocesses summed incoherently, each with its own core cuts, as MadGraph does. D4: one cut indicator per flavour group is in sprint H's scope, since it blocks every hadronic decay chain with jets in the decay and 5F p p > j j j.
* [Sprint H: register the cut_decays exemption as a deviation; integrate the b-cut cards MadGraph refuses](D5-cut-decays-exemption-and-b-cut-cards.md) - D5 (revised): MadEvent's cut_decays exemption with identical particles across a decay is a registered deviation, since reproducing it needs the single-pairing |M|² of compat site (d). D6: keep integrating the b-cut cards MadGraph refuses.
